label: Where
quote: is an alpine glacial lake located to the eastern side of Madyan in Swat District

label: Getting there
value: By four-by-four or ordinary vehicle, about 40 to 50 minutes to reach the valley
quote: The road to this valley is partly metaled and can be plied by a four by four or any ordinary vehicle. It takes almost forty to fifty minutes to reach this picturesque valley

label: Hike
value: Four to five hours of trekking from the valley to the lake, depending on the trekkers
quote: trekking of four to five hours, depending on professionalism and enthusiasm of the trekkers

label: Best months
value: April to May, for Swat in general (not specific to the lake)
quote: April to May is the best time to visit Swat, when the fresh green grass carpet covers the slopes.
source: Wikivoyage: Swat (general Swat advice, not specific to the lake)

label: Also called
quote: also known as Bashigram Danda in Pashto
